I'm glad that I came here. Dr Milind , Nikita ma'am and Sanjana Ma'am have really guided me well. I've learned to embrace life and live it to its fullest.

featured_reviews.name: C S
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking for a good counselling therapy centre for my brother in Vasai with very little hope that I would find something really good. Her therapy techniques have been such a positive transformational journey for my brother from being of very low self esteem to a confident person in last 3 months. My brother was completely stuck down in dumps about his career as well as personal relations and not sure how to move forward. Sanjana mam was absolutely brilliant in her approach and Sanjana mam helped my brother to understand himself from within and come out of self destruction. His journey is still going on with Sanjana mam and in coming months it will help him to be his best self. To top it up right medication by Dr. Barhate is helping him with faster healing. I am thankful to Manobal Therapy Centre for their excellent service and highly recommended.

I highly recommend visiting Dr.Barhate's Manobal Clinic.

name: Antarnaad Counseling Center Vasai
description:
Antarnaad counseling center at Vasai provides mental health services for stressed minds . The experienced empathic counselor listens to the problem, understands the emotional distress created by difficult situation and helps to find options to resolve it. The sessions make the person feel empowered with counselor's support. Online counseling sessions as well as one-o-one (offline)sessions are conducted in comfortable and soothing atmosphere .
Group counseling is also done for students, adolescents and parents. Art Workshops and summer camps for students are conducted during vacation. Personality development, Career counseling ,
Stress management, Behavioural management , relationship management, marital counseling are the services provided.
